mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status, t.tenant_code, t.display_name AS tenant_display_name FROM user_account u JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, username, display_name, status, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, username, display_name, status, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (tenant_id, user_id, username, display_name, status, lock_version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, 'USER', #{actorId}, #{now}, 'USER', #{actorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by_type = 'USER', updated_by_id = #{actorId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion}
